# Trame · Conventions

## Standards

<a id="DocumentIds"></a>

### Names of the documents

`DocumentIds` · `src/conventions.ts:231`

How a document of a view is named: a view of the whole graph by its name; a view of a module by its name and the module ("layers.engine"), except the first view per module, named by the module alone; a view of a node by its name and the reference of the node ("impact:engine.Compiler"), which the page reads back to show it.

Source: Trame, the documents of its views (the engine names them, the page reads them)

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ofModule` | `.` | Between the name of a view and the module it shows |
| `ofNode` | `:` | Between the name of a view and the reference of the node it shows |

- Maintained by: trame
- Used by: [Show the graph](browser.md#ShowGraph), [Compilation API](engine.md#CompilationApi), [Views](engine.md#Views)

<a id="FrozenApi"></a>

### The frozen API

`FrozenApi` · `src/conventions.ts:76`

What an assembled program calls in the prelude (trame/internal.ts, frozen): the value of a node read from its declaration, the body of an inline node, the data a rule reads, the start of the component with its entry points; and what the start gives back.

Source: Trame, the prelude (trame/internal.ts: frozen)

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `frozen` | What the prelude exports for frozen programs |
| `value` | `value` | The value of a node, read from its declaration (a rule) |
| `body` | `body` | The body of a node written inline in its declaration |
| `data` | `data` | Sets the data of a node as in force at the date of the assembly, for the rules that read it |
| `start` | `start` | Starts the component with its dependencies and its entry points |
| `limited` | `limited` | A capability: a realization limited to the methods its consumer uses (since g83) |
| `title` | `title` | The title of an entry point, given to start |
| `fields` | `fields` | The simple fields of an entry point, which the kind of the component reads |
| `entry` | `value` | What an entry point is, once built |
| `address` | `address` | What start gives back when the component answers somewhere |
| `code` | `code` | What start gives back when the component ends with an exit code |

- Maintained by: trame
- Applies: [The prelude: the runtime of the language](principles.md#PreludeLayer)
- Used by: [TypeScript writer](typescript.md#TypeScriptWriter)

<a id="ReferenceSyntax"></a>

### Trame references

`ReferenceSyntax` · `src/conventions.ts:202`

How the language names a node and a field: "module.Identifier", "value.case". An empty path designates the whole node. A module of a library takes the library's name before its own: "std/algebra.Counts".

Source: Trame, the prelude (trame/kernel.ts: refOf, getPath)

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `separator` | `.` | Separates the module from the identifier, and the steps of a path in a field |
| `library` | `/` | Separates a library's name from the name of one of its modules, in the graph that imports it |
| `wholeNode` | `""` | The empty path: the whole node, not one of its fields (refines Texts.empty) |

- Maintained by: trame
- Refines: [Texts](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/algebra.md#Texts)
- Used by: [Advance](commands.md#Advance), [Graph](engine.md#GraphApi), [References](engine.md#References), [Wiring](engine.md#Wiring), [Records of the releases](generations.md#ReleaseRecords), [Common rendering](rendering.md#Common), [TypeScript writer](typescript.md#TypeScriptWriter)

<a id="TrameCommands"></a>

### Trame's commands

`TrameCommands` · `src/conventions.ts:114`

How a person calls Trame in a terminal: the program, its commands, its options, the formats a view is written in. A word that names no command goes to the fallback command (in Trame: the name of a view); with no command, or an option first, Trame builds.

Source: Trame, its command line (the entry points of commands, in the module commands)

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `program` | `trame` | The name a person types |
| `assemble` | `assemble` | Assembles a component for an environment |
| `build` | `build` | Builds the documents of the graph |
| `dev` | `dev` | Follows the graph live in the page |
| `payload` | `payload` | Writes the graph compiled at a date, for the page |
| `export` | `export` | Writes the page, standalone |
| `publish` | `publish` | Freezes the published declarations in the lock |
| `run` | `run` | Assembles a component, then runs it |
| `view` | `view` | Shows a view |
| `snapshot` | `snapshot` | Takes the snapshot of the graph |
| `testKinds` | `test-kinds` | Tests the laws of the kinds and of the views |
| `advance` | `advance` | The generation in place assembles the described engine and checks it |
| `audit` | `audit` | Asks the registry about the packages of the graph, and keeps its answers as evidence |
| `manifest` | `manifest` | Writes the packages of the graph, at their versions, and where each library's name leads, into the project's manifest |
| `release` | `release` | Freezes a version of the project, a library: its graph, its code and its documents |
| `deliver` | `deliver` | Writes the deliveries of the project: a page a browser opens as it is |
| `ship` | `ship` | Builds a shipment's artefacts, runs its checks, refuses while an obligation does not hold, deploys it |
| `evidence` | `evidence` | Records a piece of evidence a person gives: a check made by hand, a review, a deployment |
| `doctor` | `doctor` | Asks the machine whether it runs Trame: files, trees, programs, a server, the time, the registry |
| `plan` | `plan` | Says what a build would change against the last one, and writes nothing |
| `amend` | `amend` | Changes a chosen value by an amendment, said first, then recorded where the project's amendments go |
| `registry` | `registry` | Publishes to the registry of this machine the generations and the releases frozen in the language's home |
| `init` | `init` | Starts a project in the current directory: its configuration, its first module, the guide for agents, its manifest |
| `fallback` | `*` | The command that receives a word naming no other one |
| `optionPrefix` | `-` | Opens an option, not a command |
| `at` | `--at` | The date at which the graph is compiled |
| `format` | `--format` | The format a view is written in |
| `port` | `--port` | The port trame dev listens on |
| `fragment` | `--fragment` | Writes the page as a fragment, without its document |
| `env` | `--env` | The environment a component is assembled for |
| `all` | `--all` | Every date, not only the one asked |
| `history` | `--history` | With --all, the last days of the project's history too: a version released, evidence given |
| `accept` | `--accept` | The differences an advance shows are wanted |
| `promote` | `--promote` | The candidate becomes the next generation, with what changes |
| `migrate` | `--migrate` | With publish: the published declarations that changed form, not meaning, as the language moved, are published again, with why |
| `by` | `--by` | Who gives the evidence, or writes the amendment: the person it is attributed to |
| `why` | `--why` | Why an amendment changes the value |
| `from` | `--from` | The day an amendment comes into force |
| `until` | `--until` | The last day an amendment is in force |
| `source` | `--source` | The source that changed a cited value, which the amendment names |
| `subject` | `--subject` | What was reviewed: the key of a row of data |
| `language` | `--language` | The language a row was reviewed in |
| `note` | `--note` | What the evidence says, in words |
| `url` | `--url` | Where to read more, or where an artefact was deployed |
| `dryRun` | `--dry-run` | Builds and checks, records the evidence, but does not deploy |
| `restore` | `--restore` | Given to the launcher: installs, in the pinned generation's folder, the packages it was frozen with |
| `passed` | `passed` | The evidence says yes: the check passed, the review approves, the deployment is done |
| `failed` | `failed` | The evidence says no: the check failed, the review asks for changes |
| `json` | `json` | A view written as JSON (the intermediate format) |
| `markdown` | `md` | A view written as Markdown |
| `separator` | `" "` | Separates the words of a command, and the names of a list given as one parameter |

| name | trame |
| modules | { kernel: trame/kernel, kinds/*: kinds/* } |

<a id="PreludeApi"></a>

### The prelude's public API

`PreludeApi` · `src/conventions.ts:32`

How a body names the prelude's public API (trame/kernel), the only module it may import as a value: a module whose path ends this way, written from wherever the body is. Everything else a body needs, it receives as a parameter; and kinds and views, which may import the prelude, import nothing else in its directory.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| directory | /trame/ |
| endings | /trame/kernel, /trame/kernel.ts, /trame/kernel.js, #trame/kernel |

- Decided by: trame
- Used by: [Laws](engine.md#Laws), [Static reading](engine.md#StaticAnalysis), [Checks of a body](syntax.md#BodyChecks)
- Applies: [The prelude: the runtime of the language](principles.md#PreludeLayer)

<a id="ProjectStart"></a>

### How a project starts

`ProjectStart` · `src/conventions.ts:43`

What trame init writes: the module that holds the goal the project serves (its name, the kind it declares, the field that names its owner), the guides for agents it copies from the language's home (this guide, the skill), and the file that points an agent to the guide.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| module | product |
| goal | Purpose |
| goalKind | kinds/goal |
| owner | owner |
| references | packages |
| packageKind | kinds/package |
| packageFacade | pkg |
| language | Language |
| library | Library |
| guides | AGENTS.md, .claude/skills/trame/SKILL.md |
| pointer | CLAUDE.md |
| pointerText | @AGENTS.md |

- Decided by: trame
- Rejected: An empty project, nothing would say what the project is for, and the first build would have no goal to link anything to; A template project to copy, a second project to keep in step with the language; what init writes is in the graph
